ideas.pitch: A custom out-of-order RISC-V vector co-processor implemented in Verilog designed for low-latency edge AI inference on FPGA.
ideas.title: TensorRT-Accelerated RISC-V Neural Accelerator Core
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Hardware for AI Frontier track with a rigorous Verilog-based FPGA implementation directly mimics winning hardware projects like riscv-ooo-core, impressing judges with genuine RTL design.

ideas.pitch: A precision analog circuit simulation and prototype featuring instrumentation amplifiers and active filters for high-fidelity biomedical signal acquisition.
ideas.title: MEMS-Based Low-Noise Analog Front-End for EEG Signals
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Signal Processing Frontier track by delivering a rigorous analog design that appeals to hardware-focused sponsors like Tenstorrent and IEEE judges looking for domain depth.

ideas.pitch: An automated inverse-design tool using automatic differentiation to optimize phase shifter doping profiles for silicon photonic circuits.
ideas.title: Differentiable Silicon Photonic Phase Shifter Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced differentiable programming concepts proven in past computational hardware wins, offering judges a sophisticated mathematical solution to next-generation chip design.

ideas.pitch: A pipelined MAC (Multiply-Accumulate) array in Verilog optimized for quantized convolutional neural network layer execution.
ideas.title: Ultra-Low Power Digital CNN Accelerator on FPGA
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Digital Frontier track with a clean, fully synthesizable RTL architecture that stands out among software-heavy submissions.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-software co-designed adaptive FIR filter pipeline implemented on an FPGA for multi-microphone directional audio enhancement.
ideas.title: Real-Time Edge Audio Beamforming and Noise Cancellation Processor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines real-time digital signal processing algorithms with hardware description languages, directly matching the Signal Processing Frontier track criteria.
